TRANSFERANDDISTRIBUTIONOFDEVELOPMENTRIGHTS PURSUANTTOSECTION98-33(a) OF THE ZONING RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF NEW YORK 2017,by 509-511 WEST 27 STREET LIMITED PARTNERSHIP, with an address at c/oKatsy Korins LLP, 605 Third Avenue, New York, New York 10058, Attention: Matthew Danow, Esq. (the “Transferor") and 500 W25TH OWNER LLC, with an address at c/o GDS Development, 12-16 Vestry Street, 7th Floor, New York, New York 10013 (the “Transferee"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Transferor is the owner of certain real property designated as Block 699, Lot 25 ("Lot 25") and Block 699, Lot 26 ("Lot 26") as shown on the Tax Map of the City of New attached hereto and made a part hereof (collectively, the “Granting Site"); and WHEREAS, Transferee is the owner of certain real property designated as Block 696, Lot 38, as shown on the Tax Map, and as more particularly described in Exhibit II attached hereto and made a part hereof (the “Receiving Site'); and WHEREAS, the Granting Site is a “granting site” as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York (hereinafter, the “Zoning Resolution"); and WHEREAS, the Receiving Site is a “receiving site” as defined in Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, certain “floor area,”as defined in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution, appurtenant to the Granting Site is unused and is available for transfer pursuant to Section 98-30 of the Zoning Resolution; and WHEREAS, pursuant to the provisions of Section 98-33 of the Zoning Resolution, Transferor and Transferee have notified the NewYork City Department of City Planning("DCP") of their intent to transfer (i) 2,001.25 square feet of the floor area from Lot 25 to the Receiving Site, and (ii) 2,001.25 square feet of the floor area from Lot 26 to the Receiving Site (hereinafter, the“Receiving Site Rights"); and WHEREAS, a primary access easement volume has previously been transferred to the City ofNewYork from Block 699,in accordance with the provisions of Zoning ResolutionSection 98-61; and WHEREAS, Transferor and Transferee desire to transfer the Receiving Site Rights to the Receiving Site. NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreement herein contained,it is hereby agreed asfollows:
